goals: Give structurally eligible dry upward-supported foliage canonical-parent placement and survival parity on exact native horizontal Nibaru slabs while preserving vanilla block/state identity, lifecycle, growth, harvesting, cleanup, and coherent half-height geometry.

Delegate bonemeal on exact dry bottom native Nibaru slabs for canonical Grass Block, Moss Block, and Pale Moss Block through the corresponding Minecraft 26.2 substrate implementation without broadening material or geometry ownership.
scope: Maintain C4 as the canonical-parent successor to C3: resolve an exact BGE-owned native horizontal slab, substitute only its support position with the profile's canonical parent in a read-only LevelReader projection, and let the plant state's ordinary Minecraft canSurvive result make the permission decision.

Classify behavior structurally through VegetationBlock, DoublePlantBlock, BigDripleaf head/stem, MossyCarpetBlock, and non-wool CarpetBlock contracts; root adapters cover single states, double-height companions, arbitrary big-dripleaf head/stem columns, and moss-carpet base/topper segments without a registry-ID permission table.

Align accepted bottom-slab models, outlines, targeting, cached/context collision, visual, interaction, entity-inside, breaking-overlay, and shape-derived particle geometry by exactly -0.5 Y while leaving top/double slabs and ordinary full-block behavior unshifted.

Preserve exact C3 as historical predecessor provenance and preserve its bounded Grass Block, Moss Block, and Pale Moss Block substrate-bonemeal behavior, including exact item consumption, native-slab restoration/reconciliation, generated vegetation positioning, and lowered-azalea safety.

Use exact unified BGE C58, CNM 2.0.7, Terrain Slabs 3.3.2, Java 25, Gradle 9.5.1, Loom 1.17.19, and Fabric API 0.157.0+26.2 only as controlled build/test or read-only comparison baselines; runtime dependency eligibility remains capability/provider-based.

exclusions: Crop/farmland families, ordinary and attached stems, saplings, giant-fungus starters, lily pads, and fluid-dependent or aquatic plants fail closed through behavior-class boundaries; PitcherCropBlock is included in the crop boundary because its farmland lifecycle is a DoublePlantBlock rather than a CropBlock.

Bottom-slab mushroom and azalea bonemeal transformation into larger structures fails closed because the generated structure cannot preserve equivalent half-height geometry; ordinary small-mushroom spread and accepted azalea decoration remain supported.

Vertical slabs, CNM Steps, layers, stairs, walls, columns, vanilla or foreign slabs, side-mounted and hanging plants, rails, redstone components, pressure plates, torches, machinery, and arbitrary decorations receive no projected behavior.

The read-only projection supports ordinary BlockGetter and LevelReader placement/survival contracts. Raw ChunkAccess inspection is delegated and arbitrary custom placement systems that bypass those world-view accessors are not claimed compatible.

Unified Block Geometry Extensions retains canonical material/native-slab ownership; this project adds no duplicate plant blocks, persisted offset property, registry-name parser, competing material table, or standalone Nibaru dependency.

No Test Slot, Test Instance Manager state, accepted stack, Minecraft profile, deployment, gameplay runtime result, or promotion is changed by C4 controlled validation; the protected gameplay instance remains off-limits.

state.milestone: C4 replaces the C3 species/substrate permission tables with canonical-parent projected vanilla survival for structural foliage families. A clean Java 25 build passed 4/4 focused JUnit tests and all 21 implemented headless server Fabric GameTests against exact unified BGE C58, CNM 2.0.7, and Terrain Slabs 3.3.2 baselines; artifact inspection and runtime-dependency policy validation also passed. Reload automation covered BlockState codec round-trip plus in-memory remove/reinsert rather than real chunk/world save-reload, and client rendering/mixins were statically inspected rather than executed. C4 remains ACTIVE, NOT_DEPLOYED, independently RUNTIME_UNTESTED, and unaccepted.
